title: Design system
lead: Option A, Ink and Cream. Light theme only. Colour is kept for the safety states. Everything on this page is placeholder or fake content.
demoRoleHint: Changes the navigation only. Real sign-in comes in Phase 2.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.intro: Colour, radius, shadow and type scale. Colour values are read from the live CSS tokens.

typography.title: Typography
typography.intro: DM Sans for text, Fredoka for page titles only, Noto Sans Gujarati for Gujarati. Fonts are self-hosted.
typography.sampleBody: The doctor reviews the facts, the guided questions and the safety checks before signing.
typography.safeguardBody: Both lines below are forced to uppercase, wide letter-spacing and italics. The Latin line changes. The Gujarati line ignores it, as designed.

states.title: Safety states
states.intro: Five states. Each has an icon and a text label, so colour is never the only signal.

examples.clear: Toy check T-1 found nothing. (FAKE content)
examples.acknowledge: Toy rule T-2 asks you to acknowledge before continuing. (FAKE content)
examples.blocked: Toy rule T-3 blocks this item until it is fixed or overridden with a reason. (FAKE content)
examples.unconfirmed: Heard in the conversation: toy symptom X, not yet confirmed. (FAKE content)
examples.ai: Suggested wording for a toy question. (FAKE content)

base.title: Base components
base.intro: Every control has a visible label, a keyboard path and a focus ring. Touch targets are at least 44px.
base.inputHint: Helper text sits under the field.
base.comboboxHint: Type Drug- to try it. Arrow keys move, Enter selects.
base.tooltip: Extra detail shown on hover or focus
base.bannerBlocked: Blocked until the problem is fixed.
base.emptyBody: Items you create will show up here.

diff.caption: AI proposed versus doctor final (fake sample)

modal.title: Modal dialog
modal.description: Focus stays inside until you close it.

drawer.title: Drawer
drawer.description: A side panel for secondary tasks.
drawer.body: Press Escape or use the close button to return.

clinical.title: Clinical components
clinical.intro: Stubs with realistic props. No microphone, no AI and no real rules yet.
clinical.fakeNotice: Everything below is fake or placeholder content. There are no clinical values.
clinical.editStub: Editing arrives in a later phase
clinical.overrideLogged: The override reason would be written to the audit log
